profile.name: SANKALP YERAWAR
profile.subtitle: Backend Development & Distributed Systems Architect
summary: 7+ years in backend development, distributed systems, and cloud architectures across automotive, healthcare, and manufacturing.

Built real-time streaming, HIPAA-compliant apps, and automated supply chain systems. Expertise in microservices, high-scale data processing, and cloud-native applications. Designed large-scale pipelines with Kafka, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Collaborated with clients to drive business decisions and improve product design. Passionate about clean architecture, DDD, TDD, and system optimization.
